subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar adopt a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings destination, or relocate this aggregation into an existing shared overview surface?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and maintenance-heavy surfaces, and source correctness alone cannot determine whether this dashboard deserves a permanent navigation destination.

options.title: Approve Dedicated Pane
options.body: Sponsor the top-level pane in principle, contingent on account-complete aggregation, focused regression tests, and sanitized bundled-app proof.

options.title: Reuse Shared Overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation model but move the presentation into an existing multi-provider overview to reduce permanent navigation and UI maintenance surface.

options.title: Decline Dashboard Surface
options.body: Keep existing provider-level charts and avoid adding a new cross-provider analytics destination.

recommendation.title: Approve Dedicated Pane
recommendation.body: Sponsor the top-level pane in principle, contingent on account-complete aggregation, focused regression tests, and sanitized bundled-app proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available decision owner for the VISION.md sign-off on a permanent product surface.
